title: Council sends Kiest back for a new RFP
detail: The council voted down the Kiest contract and directed that the new RFP be developed with community involvement.

sources.label: City Council Annotated Agenda, June 24, 2026, Item 60, File 26-1082

title: Park Board committee briefed on the new RFP
detail: The Ad Hoc Golf and Racquet Sports Committee received a staff briefing on the new Kiest RFP.

title: Pickleball requirement appears in draft criteria
detail: The draft criteria add pickleball programming, which could mean converting tennis courts DTEA students use after school. It was not in the previous RFP and the community has not been consulted on it.

title: Next Park Board committee meeting
detail: The Ad Hoc Golf and Racquet Sports Committee has not set its next meeting. The city has said it will notify the coalition once a date is set, and we'll post it here.

sources.label: Dallas Park and Recreation Department, email to the coalition, October 2026

title: Community listening session at Kiest
detail: We're asking the Parks Department to hold one listening session at Kiest before the RFP criteria are finalized. It has not been scheduled.

title: New Kiest RFP released
detail: The city now says the RFP specifications are still being discussed, so it won't go out in November as first expected. Once it's issued, the window to shape its criteria closes.

sources.label: Dallas Park and Recreation Department, email to the coalition, October 2026

title: Proposals scored and contract awarded
detail: Whoever is selected, we'll publish the contract's youth-programming terms and track whether they are kept.

title: Public information request filed
detail: A coalition member requested scoring sheets, evaluator records, contract history and communications about the original RFP under the Texas Public Information Act.

sources.label: City of Dallas reference no. C008273-062226

title: City asks the Attorney General to withhold records
detail: The city sought to withhold records under competitive-bidding and third-party exemptions. The requestor filed responses on July 8 and July 15.

title: Fee waiver denied
detail: The City Secretary's office issued a $652.50 invoice to compile more than 1,000 responsive records and denied the public-interest fee waiver.

title: Attorney General rules for the city
detail: The Attorney General's office allowed the city to withhold the requested records under Section 552.104, the competitive-bidding exemption.

title: Revisit the request after the new contract is awarded
detail: The competitive-bidding exemption is tied to an active procurement. Once the Kiest contract is awarded, the original RFP records may be requested again.
